newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Roh, Chun not to appeal convictions - Roh's lawyer.
newsitem.headline: Roh, Chun not to appeal convictions - Roh's lawyer.

text.p: Former South Korean presidents Roh Tae-woo and Chun Doo Hwan will not make a final appeal to the Supreme Court against their convictions for mutiny, treason and bribery, Roh's lawyer said on Monday.
"We won't appeal. President Roh doesn't want to cause any more worries to the public over this incident," Han Young-suk said.
He added that Chun also would not appeal further in what has been dubbed the "trial of the century".
Han said the only reason Roh made an initial appeal was because Chun was determined to challenge his death sentence, which was commuted to life in jail by an appeals court last Monday.
The appeals court cut Roh's jail sentence to 17 years from 22-1/2 years.
